api.note: platform.kimi.ai (formerly platform.moonshot.ai, 301-redirects) is the web console only. All programmatic calls go to api.moonshot.ai/v1. No separate international endpoint — single global endpoint.

active.description: Coding-focused successor to K2.6. Moonshot's most capable coding model. Thinking mode is always on (cannot be disabled).
active.architecture: MoE, 1T total params, 32B active per token, 384 experts (8 active + 1 shared), MLA attention, MoonViT 400M vision encoder
active.tool_calling_notes: Supports function calling (up to 128 functions). tool_choice: auto, none, required, or specific function. Thinking mode forces tool_choice to auto or none only.

variants.description: High-speed variant, ~180 tokens/s, up to 260 tokens/s in short-context scenarios

active.description: Current flagship open-weight model. Multimodal, agentic, supports thinking and non-thinking modes. All previous K2 and kimi-latest users directed here.
active.architecture: MoE, 1T total params, 32B active per token, 384 experts (8 active + 1 shared), 61 layers, 64 attention heads, MLA, SwiGLU, MoonViT 400M vision encoder

max_output_tokens.note: Varies by platform. Official quickstart example uses max_tokens=32768 (1024*32). Third-party (Apiyi) cites 98304. OpenRouter cites 262144. Treat 32768 as safe conservative limit for production; official hard cap not published.

active.tool_calling_notes: Supports function calling (up to 128 functions). In thinking mode, tool_choice limited to auto or none. Built-in $web_search incompatible with thinking mode — disable thinking to use it. Tool calls wrapped with special tokens in raw format.

active.description: Previous generation flagship. Supports visual and text input, thinking and non-thinking modes, dialogue and Agent tasks. Agent Swarm capacity: 100 sub-agents, 1500 steps.

max_output_tokens.note: AWS Bedrock lists 16384; likely platform-specific constraint. Actual limit higher but not officially published.

active.description: Legacy text-only model. 8k context. No vision.
active.note: V1 variants differ only in context length, not model capability.

upcoming.note: No official model card, benchmarks, API ID, pricing, or weights published as of 2026-07-16. Track platform.kimi.ai for announcement.

k1_5_status.note: Kimi K1.5 (released 2025-01-20) had API exposure via kimi-thinking-preview which was deprecated 2025-11-11. K1.5 is effectively superseded and has no active API model ID. No separate published deprecation date for K1.5 base; it was never exposed as a standalone API model ID.

agentic_capabilities_summary.tool_calling: Supported on K2.5, K2.6, K2.7-Code via OpenAI-compatible function-calling interface. Max 128 functions per call.
agentic_capabilities_summary.thinking_mode: K2.6/K2.5: optional (enable/disable per request). K2.7-Code: always on.
agentic_capabilities_summary.agent_swarm: K2.6 supports up to 300 domain-specialized sub-agents with 4000 coordinated steps. K2.5: 100 sub-agents, 1500 steps.
agentic_capabilities_summary.vision: K2.5, K2.6, K2.7-Code support text + image + video input via MoonViT 400M encoder.
agentic_capabilities_summary.coding_benchmark_leader: K2.7-Code: SWE-Bench best-in-class at time of release for open-weight coding models.
